content:
Investment Details and Participants

San Francisco-based multimodal AI infrastructure provider Fal.ai raised $140 million in a Series D funding round led by Sequoia. With this round, the company’s valuation reached $4.5 billion. Kleiner Perkins, NVIDIA’s investment arm NVentures, and Alkeon Capital participated in the funding round. Existing investors such as Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Kindred Ventures, and Salesforce Ventures also participated in the round.

Infrastructure and Growth Metrics

Led by Görkem Yurtseven and Burkay Gür, Fal.ai provides developers with a cloud-based API infrastructure to run image, video, and audio models. The company has now completed its third funding round following its Series B and C rounds in 2025. While billions of real-time media assets are generated monthly through the platform, the company’s run-rate revenue has doubled over the past four months.

The new funding will be allocated to the following areas:

  • Expanding the global server and computing infrastructure.
  • Expanding the engineering and go-to-market (GTM) teams.
  • Developing new multimodal product lines.
  • Accelerating the integration of models.

Fal.ai, which currently serves large-scale technology companies such as Adobe, Canva, and Shopify, provides developers with access to over 600 AI models.
